newsitem.title: ITALY: Compart H1 96 cons net profit 186 bln lire.
newsitem.headline: Compart H1 96 cons net profit 186 bln lire.

text.p: Parent company net profit 70 vs 128 loss

NOTE - Financial holding group Compart (formerly known as Ferruzzi Finanziaria) said that this was the first time since 1991 it had shown a profit at the parent company level. Due to the absence of expected tax payments, its parent company net profits of 70 billion lire was also equal to its pretax profit.

Compart said its net consolidated profit in the first half of 1995 of 287 billion lire included a capital gain of 272 billion lire from the formation of the Montell joint venture by its sister company Montedison and Anglo-Dutch group Shell.

It added that net debt had fallen to 11,602 billion lire at the end of the first half, down 1,530 billion lire from the end of 1995. Its debt/equity ratio had improved to 1 at the end of the first-half from 1.23 at the end of 1995.
